INVITATION:
The State of Tennessee is inviting General Contractor bids for the Work of this project.
Examine documents at the Designer's office or Plan Rooms on or after November 18th,
2026.
Bidding Documents in PDF format may be obtained at no cost from the following source.
Memphis Reprographics
Entities obtaining Bidding Documents become Bidders of Record for notifications. Bidders
of Record may purchase hard copies of Bidding Docum ents from the same source
(nonrefundable).
Bidders shall be licensed and qualified per state law. Five percent (5%) Bid Security is
required in the form of a Bid Bond or check (certified or cashier’s) made payable to State
of Tennessee. Non-discrimination policy applies.
